findings.description: The wrapper now reuses one statistics dict across all calls and calls stats.clear() on every invocation, so concurrent calls to the same decorated function share and wipe each other's statistics.
findings.rationale: Trigger: two threads (or overlapping calls in the same thread) invoke the same decorated function, and the second call starts while the first is still retrying. Mechanism: stats.clear() empties the dict the in-flight call is writing to, and both calls write into that same dict via copy._local.statistics. The original code gave each call its own fresh dict. Impact: wrapped_f.statistics reports counts (attempt_number, idle_for, etc.) that are reset or mixed up between calls, so users reading statistics see wrong values.
